title: jam intermediate-state digest
description: Glanceable supervision artifact. The gate hook refuses to advance unless a conforming digest exists. Must expose all four drift-detectors.

summary.description: Plain-language summary of what just happened / is about to happen.

traceToArchitecture.description: Detector 1: link current work back to the aligned architecture.

gapFromAgreed.description: Any divergence from what was agreed, or null.

decisions.description: Detector 2: design choices made this step, surfaced for taste-veto before they are buried.

globalMap.description: Detector 3: the whole-project map with current position; flags local-hack spiralling.

mermaid.description: Mermaid/Graphviz source for the project map.

activeDirectives.description: Steering directives still in force and whether this step honored them.
